title: Senior Product Designer
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: Head of design

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

They recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We are looking for an exceptional individual to help design, build and scale Nova's next generation of products, working closely with the founders and the greater founding team. We’re looking for an outstanding product designer who will:

  • Lead the design of payment experiences for both consumers and merchants, across mobile apps and desktop platforms, from research to polished, shipped product
  • Help shape Nova's product vision and design direction, influencing decisions beyond your own projects.
  • Raise the design quality bar across the product, mentoring others and improving how the whole team ships UI.
  • Operate as an important IC designer, partnering directly with founders and leaders on product vision• Build and evolve design systems ensuring scalable, accessible, and delightful UIs.
  • Prototype and test ideas rapidly, validating hypotheses with real users.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product and engineering to align design decisions with business outcomes.
  • Share work frequently in constructive design critiques and contribute to our design culture of openness and iteration.
  • Occasionally support brand and marketing initiatives (landing pages, campaigns) when your craft can raise the bar.

This is your chance to be a key player at work, working on challenging projects with significant impact, as part of a select team of members at an ambitious and unique new payment network company.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years designing digital products with a strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design, including mobile interfaces.
  • Strong visual and interaction design craft with systematic thinking.• Daily use of AI in your design workflow (research, synthesis, spec'ing, prototyping).
  • Experience working in fast-paced environments, balancing high quality with speed.
  • Full professional proficiency in English

Preferred:

  • Experience building and shipping production-quality interfaces with AI coding tools (Replit, Cursor, Claude Code, v0, etc.), reducing or removing the need for front-end handoff.
  • Experience in fintech or payments in Brazil.
  • Background in early-stage startups, especially in 0→1 environments.
  • Familiarity with user research, testing, and product analytics tools (Amplitude, Metabase).

The Target Companies

Candidates with at least 2 years of full-time experience in the companies below will be prioritized:

  • Strong Fintechs: Nubank, Revolut, Wise, Mercado Pago, Brex, Itaú, Cora
  • Strong Local Digital Product Companies: QuintoAndar, iFood, Wildlife, Mercado Livre, Globo
  • Strong Design Consultancies: Work&Co, Metalab, Huge, R/GA, Accenture Song
  • Big Tech: Google, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft
  • Other Tech: Notion, Netflix, Uber, Lyft, Airbnb, Spotify, Snap, X (Twitter), Pinterest

The Selection Process

Materials about Nova, including a pitch deck and pitch videos will be made available through the process

Portfolio Review: Async review of your portfolio by the design team to assess craft, depth of thinking, and end-to-end product work. Portfolio is required.

Screening Call: 15 min call with HR for alignment on requirements and qualifications.

Deep Dive Interview: 60 min call with Hiring Manager to deep dive on past experiences and profile.

Bar Raiser Interview: 45 min call with another leader to validate assessment with a 2nd opinion.

Cultural Fit Interview: 30 min call with CEO to evaluate culture fit and answer questions about Nova.

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Customer Experience Specialist
description:
Build the future of payments with AI, Pix & Open Finance

Type: Full-Time

Language: English

Location: São Paulo, Brazil (Hybrid)

Reports to: CPO/Product Manager

The Company

Nova is building a new generation payment network (i.e. reinventing Visa/Mastercard) using AI on top of Pix and Open Finance.

Its first product is a B2C digital wallet that functions as an infrastructure bridge between traditional credit cards and Pix, allowing consumers to use their existing credit card limits anywhere, even to pay Pix and Boletos in installments.

The company was founded by an elite team of fintech veterans and has had top-tier venture capital investors (Monashees, Canary, Canaan and Propel) since its inception.

We recently raised a large Series A and are now assembling a small team of exceptional experienced professionals to build, launch and grow its next generation of products.

The Role

We’re looking for a Customer Experience Specialist to own how Nova shows up for its customers, from the first support message to the public review that comes after it.

This role goes beyond basic ticket handling. Our first line of support is an AI agent, and a big part of your role is making it better every week: finding where it fails, feeding it the right answers, and stepping in yourself when a human is genuinely needed.

You'll own everything around it — our reputation on the App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, proactive outreach when a customer’s situation calls for it, and bringing what you hear back to Product and Marketing so we fix the root cause.

You’ll be the voice of the customer inside a small, fast-moving fintech team, with real ownership from day one.

This role is perfect for someone who:

  • Is genuinely obsessed with customer satisfaction
  • Uses AI to work better and faster, not just because it’s trendy
  • Wants to build a support operation, not just staff one

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop our AI support agent: continuously improve the AI agent that handles our first line of support — reviewing conversations, identifying gaps and failure cases, refining answers and knowledge base content, and raising the share of cases resolved without human help;
  • Handle escalations: personally respond to the cases where a human is required, with care, accuracy and speed;
  • Own our public reputation: monitor and respond across App Store, Google Play and ReclameAqui, and be accountable for our scores and response times on those channels;
  • Proactive outreach: reach out directly to customers in specific situations — failed payments, incidents, high-value or at-risk users — before they have to come to us;
  • Lead the Monthly Customer Support Meeting: prepare the data, surface the main pain points and trends, and drive follow-ups to completion;
  • Work side-by-side with Product Managers and Marketing: turn support signal into product fixes and clearer communication, and make sure customer-facing messaging matches what customers actually experience;
  • Keep things organized: support macros, help center content, processes and metrics — documented and up to date.

The Qualifications

Required:

  • Obsessed with customer satisfaction — you take it personally when someone has a bad experience;
  • Excellent Portuguese writing & communication skills — clear, warm and firm in the same message;
  • Great verbal communication — comfortable on the phone, on a call, and in front of the team. You'll be leading initiatives and reporting;
  • Comfortable with English (intermediate is enough — we work internally in English);
  • AI Native and Enthusiast: you already use AI tools to make your own work better and more efficient (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.), and you’re excited about shaping an AI agent rather than competing with it;
  • Organized and autonomous — you can own a process end to end without being chased;
  • Strong team player, curious and proactive.

Preferred:

  • Previous experience in customer support, customer success or customer experience — ideally in fintech, banking or a high-volume consumer app;
  • Familiarity with support tooling (Intercom, Zendesk or similar) and reputation channels (ReclameAqui, app store reviews);
  • Comfort with data: able to pull, read and present support metrics (volume, CSAT, first response time, resolution rate);
  • Experience dealing with sensitive topics — payments, charges, fraud, disputes;
  • Fast learner who thrives in dynamic, ambitious environments.

How You Work

  • Collaborative: open, communicative, team-oriented
  • Customer-obsessed: you listen closely and follow through
  • AI Native: you automate the repetitive so you can focus on what matters
  • Ambitious: eager to grow quickly and deliver impact
  • Owner mindset: you fix the root cause, not just the ticket

Other Requirements

  • Location: 3x per week (Tue, Wed, Thu) at our office in São Paulo
  • English mandatory

The Offer Package

  • Model: PJ
  • Compensation: aggressive salary
  • Stock Option: aggressive stock option grants
  • Other Benefits: premium health insurance, flexible hours, paid vacations and Wellhub

If you're excited about building the rails of the next generation payment network alongside a small team of high-caliber, highly motivated professionals, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Remote privacy lawyer - brazil
description:
About Moritz

Moritz is an AI-native global law firm building the next generation of commercial legal infrastructure. We combine proprietary AI tooling with a curated network of senior commercial lawyers to deliver vetted contract work at a speed and price point that traditional firms cannot match.

We serve clients globally across Europe, the US, and Australia, with active expansion into new markets including public procurement work.

We believe great commercial law is high-stakes, high-volume, and overdue for re-engineering. We hire people who want to do the best work of their careers in a small, ambitious team.

Moritz has raised a $9 M seed round from Y Combinator, 20 VC, and 20+ unicorn founders — including the founders of Dropbox, Gusto, and Instacart.

The Role

Serve as co-counsel for Moritz's privacy and data protection work in Brazil: GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliance, data processing agreements, international data transfers, DPIAs, and marketing and cookie compliance. Lead the drafting, review, and negotiation of DPAs, SCCs, joint controller arrangements, and privacy terms in commercial contracts for clients ranging from startups to midsize and enterprise companies. Advise clients on the privacy implications of deploying AI systems — training data, automated decision-making, transparency obligations, and the intersection of data protection law with the EU AI Act and equivalents. Support incident response — breach assessment, notification obligations, regulator engagement, and remediation. If you accept work with a known SLA (ex: 24hr turnaround), you must commit to meeting that SLA.

What You'll Bring

5+ years practising privacy or data protection law in private practice or in-house. Deep familiarity with GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA, and ideally one or more of: HIPAA, financial services data rules, or sector-specific regimes. International transfers expertise. SCCs, transfer impact assessments, adequacy decisions, and the practical mechanics of cross-border data flows. Working knowledge of AI and privacy. Training data, profiling, automated decision-making, and where the EU AI Act meets the GDPR. A practical, risk-based approach. You translate regulatory requirements into decisions a product team can act on. Privacy certifications (CIPP/E or similar) are a plus. Qualifications. Active license and in good standing with the bar / law society of Brazil. Professional indemnity insurance maintained or willing to obtain in line with local requirements.

Why Moritz

Work on the privacy frontier of AI deployment — not just commenting on it, but operationalizing compliance for real products. Flexible engagement: work with Moritz on a project or retainer basis alongside your existing practice. Senior team, modern tooling, and clients who value speed and clarity. Be part of a well-funded company (Y Combinator, 20 VC, 20+ unicorn founders) building category-defining legal infrastructure.

Frequently Asked Questions

How many hours will I need to commit to Moritz?

Volume depends on the scope of the client engagements you take on and can grow over time. The decision to accept, continue, or expand any engagement is made jointly between you, Moritz, and the client.

What technical requirements are needed to use Moritz's platform?

Our platform is web-based — all you need to access your Moritz matters and conduct negotiations is a reliable internet connection and word processing software. Any device you use to access the platform must meet our security requirements, which we will share during onboarding.

Am I employed by Moritz when I join the network?

No. Moritz does not employ the lawyers in its co-counsel network. Moritz is a law firm and engages clients directly; co-counsel are engaged by Moritz on an independent contractor basis to support those client matters under Moritz's supervision and quality standards. Moritz handles client intake, billing, conflicts checks, and matter management, so you can focus on the legal work.

How are co-counsel matched to client matters?

Moritz matches co-counsel to client matters based on jurisdiction, subject-matter expertise, capacity, and fit. The client engages Moritz; Moritz assigns the right co-counsel to the matter. You retain professional judgment on the legal work, while Moritz owns the client relationship, scoping, and commercial terms.

title: Revenue accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and Rev Ops on deal structuring and billing questions Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, or equivalent) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

Saa S, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or Net Suite ARM CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles Flexible remote-first work culture Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English

Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. No agro, a gente sabe que bons negócios começam com uma boa conversa, confiança e vontade de construir junto.

A Agro Busca está recebendo solicitações de clientes de várias regiões do Brasil e está formando um time de parceiros apaixonados pelo agronegócio, por tecnologia e por ajudar pessoas. Procuramos alguém com iniciativa, boa comunicação e vontade de representar a Agro Busca na sua cidade ou região.

Não buscamos apenas alguém para vender. Buscamos um parceiro capaz de ouvir, entender a realidade de cada cliente e construir relacionamentos duradouros. O que você fará

Como Parceiro(a) de Negócios Agro Busca, você atuará no desenvolvimento de novos negócios e no relacionamento com clientes e parceiros do setor agro. Acompanhará as oportunidades desde o primeiro contato até a conclusão da negociação, sempre buscando entender as necessidades do mercado e oferecer soluções adequadas ao portfólio da empresa.

No dia a dia, suas principais atividades serão:

Prospectar e desenvolver novos clientes e parceiros no setor agro. Identificar demandas e oportunidades na sua cidade ou região. Apresentar as soluções da Agro Busca de forma consultiva e clara. Participar de negociações e acompanhar cada oportunidade até a conclusão. Cultivar relacionamentos de longo prazo com clientes e parceiros. Acompanhar os resultados comerciais e contribuir para a satisfação dos envolvidos. Mapear regiões, culturas e segmentos prioritários. Apoiar ações comerciais, relacionamento e marketing. Compartilhar percepções do mercado e sugestões para aprimorar produtos e serviços. O que esperamos de você

Estamos procurando uma pessoa comunicativa, responsável e com espírito de parceria. Alguém que goste de conversar, tenha facilidade para criar vínculos e entenda que, no agro, cada região tem sua realidade e merece ser tratada com atenção.

É importante ter:

Experiência com vendas, desenvolvimento de negócios, representação comercial ou parcerias. Vivência no agronegócio ou em segmentos relacionados. Conhecer produtores, cooperativas, revendas, empresas de insumos ou outros participantes da cadeia será um diferencial. Boa comunicação, capacidade de negociação e habilidade para apresentar propostas de valor. Perfil consultivo, com capacidade de ouvir, compreender necessidades e propor soluções. Organização, autonomia e disciplina para trabalhar de forma remota. Facilidade com ferramentas digitais, como videoconferência, CRM, planilhas e aplicativos de comunicação. Conhecimento básico ou intermediário sobre o mercado agro, suas culturas, canais de distribuição e dinâmica comercial. Formação e disponibilidade

Formação em Administração, Agronegócios, Gestão Comercial, Marketing ou áreas relacionadas será considerada um diferencial, mas valorizamos principalmente a experiência prática, o conhecimento regional e a capacidade de construir bons relacionamentos.

Também é desejável ter disponibilidade para eventuais viagens, reuniões presenciais com clientes e participação em eventos do setor. Modelo de atuação

Atuação remota. Regime de contrato/parceria. Oportunidade de atuação exclusiva por cidade ou região, conforme disponibilidade. Necessidade de organização, autonomia e uso eficiente de ferramentas digitais. Participação em um programa de remuneração competitivo, alinhado ao desenvolvimento dos negócios. Por que fazer parte da Agro Busca?

Porque aqui você não será apenas mais um contato em uma lista. Queremos construir uma rede de parceiros que conheça sua região, entenda as pessoas e ajude a Agro Busca a chegar cada vez mais longe.

Se você gosta do agro, acredita no poder da tecnologia e tem vontade de crescer construindo junto, talvez essa oportunidade seja para você.

Envie sua apresentação pelo Linked In e informe a cidade ou região onde gostaria de atuar.

No agro, ninguém constrói nada sozinho. É com confiança, trabalho e parceria que a gente vai mais longe.

title: Professor de espanhol
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Immigration paralegal (immigration court / removal defense)
description:
Are you ready to build a meaningful career defending immigrants facing deportation? Do you thrive in fast‑paced environments, stay calm under pressure, and want to fight for people who need it most?

If so, Bueno Law wants to meet you.

About Bueno Law

Bueno Law is a Queer‑owned immigration law firm dedicated to protecting LGBTQ+ immigrants, survivors of domestic violence and human trafficking, and other marginalized communities.

We specialize in:

Removal Defense (EOIR). Asylum & Humanitarian Relief (U/T visas, VAWA, SIJS). Family‑Based Immigration.

We’re expanding our Removal Defense Team and seeking passionate, detail‑driven Paralegals committed to making a real impact.

What You’ll Do (Removal Defense Focus)

Support EOIR litigation by preparing filings, motions, briefs, and applications for relief (asylum, cancellation, waivers, adjustment, etc.). Draft client declarations and gather evidence for high‑stakes court submissions. Manage a removal‑defense caseload, track deadlines, and maintain accurate case records. Prepare hearing packets, organize exhibits, and assist attorneys with trial preparation. Communicate with clients—often in emotionally sensitive situations—to collect facts and provide updates. Coordinate with interpreters, experts, and agencies to support case strategy. Prepare and file USCIS petitions for clients with mixed EOIR/USCIS matters.

What We’re Looking For

Hard Skills

Fluent in English + Spanish or Portuguese. 3 years experience in with end to end removal defense (need experience with litigation). Strong legal writing, research, and evidence‑gathering skills. Highly organized and detail‑oriented with the ability to manage a heavy caseload. Tech‑savvy and fully equipped for remote work (computer, internet, private workspace, noise‑canceling headphones).

Soft Skills

Emotionally intelligent communicator who can support clients during stressful moments. Thrives in fast‑paced, mission‑driven environments. Team‑oriented, proactive, adaptable, and solutions‑focused. A sense of humor—because the work is intense, and we believe in supporting each other.

Preferred Qualifications

3 + years of immigration paralegal experience. Experience with both EOIR and USCIS filings.

What We Offer

Competitive pay above market rate. Paid vacation + sick leave. Your birthday off. U. S. paid holidays. Mon–Fri, 9 AM–6 PM PST. A mission‑driven, inclusive, supportive team.

title: Supervisor técnico operacional (remoto)
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Supervisor Técnico Operacional – Remoto

Atribuições Apoiar as equipes técnicas durante as atividades de montagem, instalação e manutenção em campo. Participar das atividades de startup, comissionamento e colocação em operação dos equipamentos, em conjunto com as equipes mecânica, elétrica e de automação. Ajustar e parametrizar equipamentos elétricos e eletrônicos, garantindo seu correto funcionamento. Auxiliar na verificação das interfaces e da integração entre os diferentes módulos e sistemas da planta. Realizar configuração, testes e suporte em sistemas de comunicação industrial, como Profinet, Profibus, PROFIBUS PA, AS-Interface e outros protocolos aplicáveis. Acompanhar remotamente os principais parâmetros operacionais das plantas de biogás/biometano, identificando desvios de processo, alarmes e condições anormais de operação. Atuar no diagnóstico de falhas considerando a integração entre automação, instrumentação, equipamentos e processo de produção de biogás/biometano. Apoiar a análise de variáveis de processo relacionadas à produção, tratamento, compressão e/ou utilização do biogás/biometano, conforme a configuração de cada planta. Interpretar tendências e históricos de processo para auxiliar na identificação de causas de falhas e na prevenção de paradas operacionais. Ter visão sistêmica da operação da planta, compreendendo a relação entre equipamentos, instrumentos, válvulas, sistemas de controle e as etapas do processo de biogás/biometano. Atuar de forma preventiva na identificação de condições que possam comprometer a disponibilidade, segurança ou eficiência operacional das plantas.

Qualificações Técnico / Engenharia Elétrica, Automação, Instrumentação ou áreas correlatas. Conhecimento em Autocad, Eplan, programação Siemens e Rockwell. Conhecimento em instrumentação industrial / válvulas, transmissores, sensores; Conhecimento em rede ASI, Profibus, Profinet; Habilitação categoria B.

.

Será visto como um diferencial:

Será considerado um diferencial relevante possuir experiência no segmento de biogás e/ou biometano, especialmente em operação, automação, instrumentação ou suporte técnico de plantas. É desejável que o profissional tenha capacidade de compreender o processo produtivo e relacionar variáveis de processo, alarmes, instrumentos e equipamentos às condições de operação da planta, contribuindo para diagnósticos mais rápidos, prevenção de falhas e maior disponibilidade operacional.

Benefícios Regime de contrato CLT. Regime Home Office Totalpass Salário competitivo ao do mercado. Vale transporte. Vale refeição (Flash Benefícios) Plano de saúde. Plano Odontológico Seguro de vida

Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Sales manager
description:

Fornecer feedback de mercado sobre demanda dos clientes, tendências de produtos, preços e condições competitivas.

Qualificações Experiência ou conhecimento em comunicação óptica, produtos de fibra óptica, equipamentos de telecomunicações, produtos de redes ou outros produtos técnicos B2 B relacionados. Bom conhecimento de produtos de comunicação por fibra óptica e suas aplicações. Capacidade de compreender as necessidades dos clientes e apoiar a seleção das soluções e produtos adequados. Boas habilidades em desenvolvimento de clientes, vendas e comunicação empresarial. Capacidade de coordenar RFQs, cotações, fornecedores e oportunidades de projetos. Boa capacidade de comunicação em inglês.

Competências Preferenciais Experiência em vendas ou desenvolvimento de negócios de produtos de fibra óptica ou telecomunicações. Familiaridade com cabos de fibra óptica, transceptores ópticos, componentes ópticos passivos e produtos de distribuição de fibra. Experiência de trabalho com operadoras de telecomunicações, integradores de sistemas, distribuidores, empreiteiros ou clientes corporativos. Experiência no suporte a RFQs, licitações, cotações ou vendas baseadas em projetos. Conhecimento de aplicações como FTTx, interconexão de data centers, redes corporativas, transmissão de telecomunicações e comunicação industrial .

Remuneração e Modelo de Cooperação

Modelo de cooperação flexível, baseado no desempenho e na contribuição para os negócios.

Os termos da cooperação e a remuneração serão definidos de acordo com o desenvolvimento de clientes, oportunidades qualificadas, progresso de RFQs, desenvolvimento de projetos e resultados comerciais.

Os detalhes relevantes serão confirmados antes do início da cooperação ou da execução de qualquer projeto.

Declaração de Igualdade de Oportunidades

A Solution Mall está comprometida com a diversidade, a inclusão e a igualdade de oportunidades de cooperação.

Como se Candidatar

Candidate-se através do Linked In ou envie seu currículo para:

tony@

Assunto do e-mail:

Candidatura – Gerente de Vendas – Produtos de Comunicação Óptica

About the Company

In the optical communication sector, Solution Mall supports products and solutions for telecom networks, data centers, enterprise networks, broadband access, industrial communication, and other fiber-based communication applications.

Preferred Skills Experience in sales or business development of fiber-optic or telecom products Familiarity with fiber optic cables, transceivers, passive optical components, and fiber distribution products Experience working with telecom operators, system integrators, distributors, contractors, or enterprise customers Experience supporting RFQs, tenders, quotations, or project-based sales Understanding of FTTx, data center interconnection, enterprise networks, telecom transmission, or industrial communication applications

Compensation and Cooperation Model

Flexible cooperation based on performance and business contribution. Cooperation terms and compensation will be determined based on customer development, qualified opportunities, RFQ progress, project development, and business results. Relevant details will be confirmed before cooperation or project work begins.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Solution Mall is committed to diversity, inclusion, and equal cooperation opportunities.

How to Apply

Apply through Linked In or send your resume to: tony@

title: Product analyst - vmake · brazil
description:
Why We Need You

As our Product Analyst, you’ll combine product thinking, user research, and data-driven insights to help shape features that resonate with Brazilian creators.

You’ll work closely with Product Managers, Designers, Engineers, and the creator community to identify opportunities, validate ideas, and ensure our product solves real user problems. Your understanding of short-form video trends, creator workflows, and AI-powered content creation will directly influence our product roadmap.

What You’ll Do Become a power user of Vmake’s AI video tools by testing new features, identifying usability issues, and evaluating the overall creator experience. Analyze user behavior, creator feedback, and product metrics to uncover opportunities for product improvements. Monitor trends across Tik Tok, Instagram Reels, You Tube Shorts, Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, and emerging creator platforms, translating market insights into actionable product recommendations. Partner with Product Managers to define product requirements, prioritize enhancements, and support roadmap planning. Conduct competitive research on AI-powered creative tools and video editing platforms, identifying best practices and product gaps. Gather, organize, and synthesize qualitative and quantitative user feedback into clear product recommendations. Collaborate closely with Design and Engineering teams throughout feature discovery, testing, and iteration. Assist in defining success metrics and evaluating feature performance after launch. Create documentation including product briefs, user stories, competitive analyses, and feature specifications.

Who You Are 3–5 years of experience in Product, Product Analysis, Product Operations, or a related product role within Saa S, AI, creator economy, social media, or e-commerce technology. Strong understanding of the Brazilian creator ecosystem and short-form video platforms. Familiarity with AI-powered creative tools and enthusiasm for generative AI technologies. Experience translating customer pain points into clear product requirements. Strong analytical thinking with the ability to interpret both qualitative and quantitative data. Excellent communication skills and experience working cross-functionally with Product, Design, and Engineering. Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications Active content creator with a public portfolio or social media presence. Experience with Tik Tok Shop, Amazon, Shopify, or creator-focused commerce platforms. Experience conducting user interviews, usability testing, or product discovery. Familiarity with wireframing tools such as Figma. Experience using analytics tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA4, or similar platforms.

SOBRE A VAGA

A Doppa conecta pessoas que querem se tornar criadoras de conteúdo a marcas licenciadas do setor de apostas esportivas e cassino online (i Gaming), um dos segmentos mais aquecidos do mercado digital brasileiro hoje.

Estamos buscando pessoas sem experiência prévia em criação de conteúdo que queiram aprender, na prática, a produzir vídeos curtos para redes sociais e ser remuneradas por isso desde o primeiro vídeo. 

Não exigimos portfólio, equipamento profissional ou seguidores. Exigimos disposição para aprender e consistência.

Você vai entrar por um processo seletivo estruturado e, se aprovado, seguir uma trilha de formação com remuneração crescente conforme desenvolve sua habilidade.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER?

Gravar vídeos curtos (formato reels/shorts) usando apenas um celular, seguindo as diretrizes fornecidas pela Doppa.

Produzir conteúdo para marcas parceiras devidamente licenciadas pela SPA/MF (Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas).

Evoluir dentro da trilha de progressão da Doppa conforme volume e qualidade dos vídeos.

PONTOS DE ATENÇÃ O

É imprescindível ter mais do que 18 anos para se candidatar.

Trabalhamos exclusivamente com operadores licenciados pela SPA/MF e seguimos rigorosamente a Portaria SPA/MF nº 1.231/2024, que regula a publicidade do setor de apostas no Brasil.

Toda comunicação produzida na Doppa segue diretrizes claras de transparência: identificação de parceria, exibição de licença e proibição de qualquer promessa de retorno garantido.

Não trabalhamos com discurso de "ganhar dinheiro fácil". Trabalhamos com formação real de criadores dentro de um setor regulamentado, sério e em expansão.

title: Fp&a manager - remote (work from anywhere)
description:
About the job

Own Saa S Financial Planning. Drive US Business Strategy. Lead from Brazil.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting and finance professionals directly into their teams. In Mexico, we focus on building long-term partnerships — where professionals operate as a true extension of US finance teams, not just offshore support.

This is not traditional outsourcing. You will work directly with US founders, Controllers, and finance leaders in lean, fast-moving environments.

The Opportunity

We are hiring an FP& A Manager to lead financial planning and analysis for US-based Saa S clients with structured corporate finance operations. You will own the full planning cycle — from budget build to monthly reporting — while acting as a strategic finance partner to US CFOs and business leaders.

This role is designed for an experienced FP& A professional who understands Saa S unit economics, recurring revenue models, and how finance drives decision-making in high-growth tech companies.

What You Will Own Lead annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting for US Saa S clients Build and maintain financial models covering ARR, MRR, churn, and unit economics Own monthly variance reporting with actionable business commentary for US leadership Partner with US CFOs and senior leaders on strategic planning and scenario analysis Develop KPI dashboards and financial performance frameworks Analyze Saa S metrics including CAC, LTV, gross margin, and cohort retention Support board-level reporting, investor presentations, and fundraising data Drive improvements in financial planning processes and tooling

What We're Looking For 6+ years of FP& A experience in Saa S or corporate finance environments Strong understanding of Saa S business models, metrics, and recurring revenue dynamics Experience working within or directly supporting corporate-structured Saa S companies Advanced financial modeling and analytical capabilities Proficiency with FP& A or BI tools (Anaplan, Adaptive, Pigment, Tableau, or Excel) Advanced English with strong executive communication skills Ability to work consistently in US time zone overlap

Why Join MAVI? Direct partnership with US CFOs and Saa S finance leadership teams Own strategic FP& A for high-growth US tech businesses Exposure to corporate-level finance in a fully remote setup Competitive compensation and long-term client partnerships Fast-track path into VP Finance and CFO-track roles

title: Video editor
description:
We are…

A leading digital media and content production group with a large global presence. At EMP, we believe in the power of content to unite and inspire people. With our innovative approach and content-first mentality, we're redefining how content is consumed and shared. We help create content at the highest level including some of the biggest professional athlete led podcasts in the world.

Like all winning teams, we value respect, creativity, and fun. Here at EMP, we provide an opportunity for your voice to be heard and create a space where you can have fun in the process. We’re not just about work, rather we look to build a community that celebrates victories, learns from hardships, and grows as one. EMP is a place where your talent can shine while you make a real impact along the way.

You Are...

An experienced and driven video editor professional with experience producing quality video edits, ideally within the media, entertainment, or sports industry. You are passionate about growth, entrepreneurial in spirit, and able to work in collaboration with a team

You Will...

Edit audio and video for podcast, You Tube videos, advertisments, branded content, Social content and more to create high-quality, color corrected, synchronized video content. Ensure audio clarity, correct sync issues, and enhance sound quality with noise reduction, EQ, and other techniques. Add intro/outro music, sound effects, and transitions for a professional and polished final product. Select impactful or interesting moments from episodes to create shorter video clips for social media platforms (e.g., Instagram, You Tube, Tik Tok). Tailor clips for specific platform requirements (aspect ratios, length, captioning) and audience engagement. Add dynamic motion graphics, lower thirds, captions, and animations to enhance viewer experience. Create and integrate title cards, branding elements, and background visuals in alignment with the podcast’s visual identity Work closely with hosts, producers, and social media managers to align on styles, themes, key messages, and desired tone and more...

Job Requirements

You Have...

The ability to speak advanced to fluent English Minimum 2-3 years of experience in video editing, preferably with podcast or interview-style content. Skills Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or similar video editing software; familiarity with audio software (e.g., Audacity, Adobe Audition) is a plus. Strong understanding of sound design, color correction, and high level motion graphics/animations. Excellent attention to detail and quality control in all aspects of editing. Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with multiple teams. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. Demonstrated experience through a portfolio of video editing work.

title: Agente comercial | uberlândia

#Vem Ser MAG

Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

title: Supervisor técnico de tubulação
description:
Sobre a Gruen

Fundada no Brasil em 2020, com sede em São Paulo, a Gruen conta com um time de engenharia atuando tanto localmente quanto na Alemanha o que assegura o desenvolvimento do processo mais eficiente para cada projeto. Nossa missão é entregar a melhor tecnologia para purificação de biogás com o menor consumo de energia entre todos os processos disponíveis no mercado.

Nossas soluções são específicas e feitas sob medida de acordo com a necessidade dos nossos clientes: pré-tratamento do gás, remoção de CO2 e N2, optional CO2 capture and storage ou liquefação, Liquefação de CH4 ou compressão de 250bar – desde o projeto inicial até a gestão da operação da planta, garantindo satisfação total de nossos clientes.

Fabricação e assistência técnica locais resultam em redução de custo e aumento de eficiência.

Soluções para contratos de manutenção e operação das plantas viabilizam a redução da complexidade e de custos.

Nossa motivação é desenvolver soluções viáveis na geração de energia limpa e sustentável para a preservação do nosso planeta e das gerações futuras.

Supervisor Técnico de Tubulação

Atribuições Coordenar e fiscalizar as equipes terceirizadas responsáveis pela montagem de tubulações e equipamentos. Planejar e acompanhar a execução das atividades de campo, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e metas do projeto. Verificar a conformidade dos serviços executados com desenhos, isométricos, especificações técnicas e procedimentos de montagem. Acompanhar a instalação de tubulações, suportes, válvulas, acessórios e equipamentos associados aos sistemas de gás. Garantir o cumprimento dos requisitos de Saúde, Segurança, Meio Ambiente e Qualidade (SSMA/QSMS), promovendo uma cultura de trabalho seguro. Realizar inspeções de campo, identificar desvios e implementar ações corretivas para assegurar a qualidade da execução. Coordenar a interface entre as equipes de engenharia, planejamento, inspeção, segurança, operação e empresas contratadas. Acompanhar testes de pressão, estanqueidade e demais atividades de comissionamento relacionadas aos sistemas de tubulação. Controlar o avanço físico das obras, elaborar relatórios técnicos e registrar ocorrências relevantes. Validar medições dos serviços executados pelas empresas terceirizadas, quando aplicável. Apoiar a resolução de problemas técnicos durante a execução das atividades, buscando soluções que minimizem impactos no cronograma. Assegurar a correta utilização de materiais, equipamentos e recursos disponibilizados para a obra. Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento com clientes, fornecedores e empresas contratadas, apresentando o status das atividades e os principais indicadores.

Qualificações Cursos técnicos em Mecânica, Tubulação Industrial ou áreas correlatas. Experiência em coordenação e fiscalização de empresas terceirizadas de montagem industrial. Vivência em projetos de redes de distribuição de gás, gasodutos, city gates ou plantas industriais. Conhecimento em leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, P& ID, isométricos e fluxogramas. Conhecimento das normas ASME B31.3, ASME B31.8, API 1104, NR-13, NR-33, NR-35 e demais normas aplicáveis ao setor. Experiência com testes hidrostáticos, pneumáticos, testes de estanqueidade e atividades de comissionamento. Conhecimento em planejamento e controle de obras, gestão de cronogramas Habilidade em liderança, negociação, tomada de decisão, resolução de conflitos e gestão de equipes terceirizadas. Domínio do Pacote Office e familiaridade com sistemas de gestão de manutenção, obras ou ERP será considerado um diferencial. CNH categoria B e disponibilidade para deslocamentos e acompanhamento de obras em campo.

Será visto como um diferencial: Experiência no setor de gás natural, petróleo, energia ou indústria de processos. Certificações em gestão de projetos, inspeção de tubulação ou soldagem.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!

Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!

A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.

*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*

O que oferecemos?

Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados . Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais. Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas. Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar. Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade. Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser). Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas. Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você .

Necessário:

Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.

O diferencial?

Aqui você é mais que um professor.

Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.

Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.

Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.

Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.

Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!

O que eu faço?

Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as

Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.

QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.

Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.

Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

description:

We are looking for a sharp, persuasive Customer Support Specialist to join our team and take ownership of refund disputes, chargeback defence and escalated customer communications. People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for a Financial Crime Analyst to identify suspicious activity and ensure we’re treating customers fairly. You’ll be investigating internal SARs and complex cases by applying judgement, analytical skills, and solid decision-making to identify where grounds for suspicion of money laundering exist.

To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What you'll be doing Reviewing, investigating, and reporting financial crime cases Providing ongoing monitoring and resolving formal complaints and Financial Ombudsman Service complaints Dealing appropriately with consent refusals following SAR submissions Acting as a point of contact for law enforcement agencies in ongoing criminal investigations that commenced from a submitted SAR Acting in accordance with written policies, procedures, and relevant legislation Cooperating with other teams by providing professional and efficient front-line compliance support, seeking to improve company processes

What you'll need A bachelor's degree (must be able to provide a certificate) 3+ years in financial crime investigations, or 1+ years of SAR reporting experience Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level) Experience working in a regulated or policy-driven environment (e.g., financial institutions, law enforcement) Experience with investigative methodologies, evidenced by the use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) The ability to work with multiple stakeholders and take ownership of assigned workload Adaptability and experience with fast-cycle feedback To be able to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends

Nice to have Fluency in other languages A degree in law or a STEM subject A professional certification (e.g., ICA or ACAMS) Familiarity with jurisdiction-specific financial regulations Experience in crypto or blockchain analysis

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday.

We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

title: Crypto operations specialist
description:
About us

Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.

About the role

Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.

What you will do Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts. Work with non-custodial wallets (Meta Mask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum. Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets. Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out. Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed. Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team. Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage. Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem. Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here. Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.

What we are looking for At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side. Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong. Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits. Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals. Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit. Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did. Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support. Stable internet connection and your own computer.

Nice to have Experience with De Fi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows. Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar. Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange. Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.

What the role offers Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year Paid vacation Full medical insurance Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company Budget for professional courses and certifications Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains
